tasks.do: Write out the full `execution` signature pattern and say which parts are optional.

Distinguish `com.acme.*` from `com.acme..*`.
Distinguish `(..)` from `()` in a parameter position.
Write an expression matching all methods of a package and its subpackages.
Write an expression matching by return type and by parameter type.
Use `within`, and say when it beats an equivalent `execution`.
Distinguish `@annotation`, `@within`, `@target`, and `@args`.
Distinguish `args` from `execution` parameter matching.
Distinguish `this` from `target`, including how proxy type changes the answer.
Use the Spring-only `bean()` designator.
Combine expressions with `&&`, `||`, `!` and named pointcuts.
Bind an annotation instance and read its attributes inside advice.
`*` = exactly one element; `..` = zero or more.
`@annotation` is method-level; `@within` is type-level.
`args` matches RUNTIME types; `execution` parameters match DECLARED types.
`this` = the proxy, `target` = the target — they diverge under JDK proxying.
`bean()` is Spring-only, not AspectJ.
A typo in a pointcut matches nothing and reports nothing.
A `@Pointcut` method must be `void` with an empty body.
